OKT3 treatment in refractory pediatric heart transplant rejection. J Heart Lung Transplant 2005; 24: 1793–7. Administration in children. The initial recommended doses in children given muromonab-CD3 for acute allograft rejection are as follows: • those weighing 30 kg or less: 2.5 mg daily • those weighing more than 30 kg: 5 mg daily Doses are given by intravenous injection for 10 to 14 days. Paediatric patients are known to have higher CD3 lymphocyte counts than adults, and often require doses to be titrated upwards. The initial dose may be subsequently adjusted in 2.5 mg incre- ments to achieve T-cell clearance (CD3-positive cells less than 25 cells/mm3) and ensure therapeutic serum concentrations of muromonab-CD3 (of 800 nanograms/mL or greater, see Thera- peutic Drug Monitoring, above).
